Dialogs.Dialog: Yeah, I was just thinking the same thing. Did my thoughts reach you？
I've got things to do once I get home. Let's just walk back together, sorry.
Got it. Shall we head out, then？
Yeah, that's a good spot. It's settled, then!
Yeah, that sounds good to me.
Don't worry, I'm sure it'll be fun!
You're right. Since you took the time to ask, let's go!
Sorry, I have errands to run. We can at least walk home together, though.
Guess I'll settle for that for today.
Hmm, that's what you picked？ All right, you pass.
Really？ Good. Let's go with that, then.
Yeah, seems like a safe bet, doesn't it？
Come on, let's give it a shot.
How could you say something like that right now？ I'm going home.
Heading straight home？ Hey, if you'd like, wanna go hang out somewhere？
I'm not really in the mood.
Really？ Yay! I know it was short notice.
I'm always free for you, ●. So, where should we go？
I see, it was pretty sudden... Can we at least walk home together？
Ah, there you are. You took so long, I was getting worried.
Is it that time already？ Sorry about that.
Making your girlfriend come all the way to you... What's the big idea, mister？
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲... Sorry, I was running late getting ready.
Hey, now. Still not ready？ Hurry it up, okay？
You came all this way. Sorry about that.
Huh, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？ Did you come all the way here for me？
This way, we get to be together a little longer.
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？ If you'd told me, I would've come over to you.
It's fine. I wanted to come see you anyway.
▲主人公＊▲! I came to get you 'cause I couldn't wait.
Thanks. I'll get ready right away.
Oh, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲, you came to meet me.
...He wouldn't leave a girl in my class alone, so I... had a little talk with him. That's all, really？
Hey there. Hmmm, he's pretty cute.
Hands off, now. He's all mine.
(Huh？ She's not here. I'm sure I heard her voice, though...？)
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲. Where were you？ You kept calling out for ●, didn't you？
？ No, I only called for you once？
You looked so similar from behind... Sorry about that.
(I mean, we do all wear the same uniform, but...)
Hey, this is your girlfriend, right？
How'd you score such a gorgeous older girl！？ Tell me your secrets!
How did you "score" me, again？ Why not tell him？
Hey, sounds like those girls are gossiping about you？
It's not about ●, it's about ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
Huh, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？ What were you doing？
...See those two over there？ They're a lovey-dovey couple from my class.
Wh-What!? No! I just, you know... thought it'd be good reference...
That guy over there... Is it just me, or is he looking this way？
Ah... He actually confessed to me the other day.
Of course I turned him down. After all, I have you. Right？
Ah, there he is! I win.
Aww, another loss! Well, see ya, have fun on your date too!
My friend and I were racing to see whose boyfriend would get here first.
Yeah, the charm from my pencil case. I really liked that one, too.
If you can't find it, why not check the staff room？
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？ I was just wondering whose it was...
Ah, that's mine! Thank goodness it turned up!
Here you go. I kept it safe from this peeping Tom's clutches.
Huh, did I drop my handkerchief？
Sorry to keep you waiting! Isn't this handkerchief yours？
Ah, that's it! How did you know it was ●'s？
Because I've memorized ev-er-y single thing of yours.
Did you have plans for something？
...Hmm, our date is in my planner, so... it's probably nothing. All good.
Got a text, hold on a sec. ...Hehe.
It's from the candy shop lady. She sent a photo saying, 'I bet you haven't tried this candy!'
(She gets updates on new sweets from the candy shop...？)
Well, did I get you？ Operation Distraction♪
(Is she reading while walking？ Talk about intense focus...)
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲！ Look out, that's a wall！
……That was close. Thanks for warning me.
You shouldn't read while walking... It's dangerous.
Sorry about that！ Is everyone okayー？
We're fine, but be careful out thereー！
Total fluke, though... Maybe it's the power of love？
Sorry! I saw a katsu sandwich left at the school store and I just had to...
A katsu sandwich？ Those always sell out during lunch break, though.
Right？ It's a miracle. If I can recreate it, maybe Dixie's could add it to the menu.
I like the sound of that.
Someone invited me to go shopping on my way out.
Yep, a girl friend. ...Wait, were you worried about me？
Kind of. Seems like a lot of guys have their eye on you, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲...
Waiting for your girlfriend？ She's really pretty.
Oh, speak of the devil. See yaー！
Well, you looked pretty happy chatting and laughing with that girl, didn't you？
You've got it all wrong, seriously！
Yeah, bye. Sorry to keep you waiting, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
I said something first, but you answered your friend before me...
...I guess I get worked up when it comes to you. That's no good, I'll reflect on that.
Sorry to startle you... I was just so moved by the book I was reading...
Whoa, he made a girl cry... Trouble in paradise？
Well then, shall we go... Ah！
There was a stray tanuki! Aw, I really wanted to take a picture!
(A tanuki... Was she just seeing things？)
That smell... Is it curry？ Wonder if the cooking club is making some...
You can't be dawdling around here. It's already time to meet, you know？
Haha, the smell of curry just lured me in.
Huh？ ...You're right. Smells delicious! Want to take a peek？
Haha, we're on a date today, remember？
I'm sorry. Really, I'm so sorry. ...Someone came to me for advice, and I just couldn't cut it short.
I see. But who was it, keeping ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ for so long...？
My teacher talks forever, you know...
(Even teachers come to ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ for advice...)
(...That's ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ over there, right？ Why isn't she coming over？)
Observing 'my boyfriend waiting alone at the gate.' You were adorable.
('Waiting alone'... How long was she planning to keep me waiting？)
If it's about the handouts, I collected everyone's and left them on your desk in the staff room.
Oh, right! Man, you're a lifesaver!
(That startled me. Even teachers rely on ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ way too much...)
Looks like there's a fight over there... Let's move away.
Glad we didn't get dragged into that.
I really hate violence... Just watching it scares me.
Alright! Let's shake it off and have some fun!
I wonder if ● will wear a suit and work like that someday, too...
Why do you say that like it's such a bummer？
Well, when that time comes, I'll tie your necktie for you.
Really？ Now I'm actually looking forward to it.
Looks like there are other couples besides ● and me.
Yeah. But isn't their distance a little awkward？ Maybe they're just friends？
Nah, at that distance, they've gotta be a couple.
Then my vote goes to just friends.
...That couple is really making out right in public...
Don't stare. Jeez... doing that in public is really bad manners.
Yeah. Don't they care that people are watching？
You watch out too, okay？ You tend to get totally lost in the moment.
Look, that guy kind of looks like you.
He does! Around the nose... and the mouth... and maybe the eyes too？
That's way more than just 'kind of', isn't it？
Nope, still just kind of. Comparing you two, you're way more handsome anyway.
...Wasn't that guy running by the school gate earlier？ Did he run all the way here？
I see, so guys diet too. Mm-hmm, makes sense.
(To ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲, jogging always means dieting, huh...)
Hey, miss! You by yourself right now？
Thanks for protecting me. You looked really cool.
(...Whoa. That woman's outfit is something else...)
Maybe I should try wearing something sexy like that too.
I just thought that way you'd stop sneaking peeks at other girls. What do you say？
Huh？ Is there something in the shadows over there...？
Eek! What if it's a ghost？ A crucifix or something？
(Pretty sure that's not how it works...)
Sorry, in the middle of our date. I'll make it quick.
Huh？ It was a wrong number？
Yeah. He even asked if he could call again. I turned him down, though.
(Hit on via wrong number... ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ is way too popular...)
She has a baby in her tummy, you know.
Huh!? I had no idea, I thought it was just her build...
Hey! Don't say such insensitive things.
Today was the half-off sale at the supermarket... Oh well, can't be helped.
(▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ seems to really know how to pinch pennies...)
Did you notice that girl we just passed had an X on her nail？ It's a little charm to make your love come true.
Huh... Girls really love that kind of thing. Do you do stuff like that, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
Not me？ I don't need to, do I？
Oh, do you mind if I stop by the ATM real quick？
Sure. ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲, you seem like you're really on top of your savings.
Not at all, I'm pretty average. Though I do keep a budget book.
(Is it really normal for a high school girl to keep a budget book...？)
Ah... ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲, over here. It's the disciplinary teacher!
Hmm... We're not doing anything wrong, so why are you hiding？
Now that you mention it... Why am I？ Just instinct, I guess...
Ah, right! Um, sorry to interrupt!
I wonder what that was about？ It was like he ran away...
Even though we'll see each other at school tomorrow... I still feel lonely. Can I call or text you later？
It's goodbye for now... but we'll see each other again tomorrow.
I want to see you tomorrow, too. It's our day off, so we can be together the whole time.
Bye-bye. It's our day off tomorrow, but no lazing around, okay？
I know, I know. See you later.
See you after the break, then...
I'll be in touch. See ya.
